description: This is a Dart source file for a Flutter service called FileService. It provides functionalities for picking files via a file picker, saving them into the application's documents directory with unique filenames, generating metadata, detecting MIME types, and deleting stored files. It also defines a data model class 'SavedFileMetadata' to hold file information.

classes.name: SavedFileMetadata
classes.description: A data model representing metadata of a file saved locally by the app, including name, MIME type, size, and local path.

methods.name: pickAndSaveFiles
methods.description: Opens a file picker dialog allowing the user to select one or multiple files, saves each into the app's documents directory with a unique filename, and returns their metadata.

methods.name: _savePickedPlatformFile
methods.description: Handles saving a single platform file into the app's documents directory with a unique filename, copying directly from path if available, or falling back to reading bytes/stream, and generating metadata.

methods.name: _resolveUniqueTargetFile
methods.description: Generates a unique File object within the app's documents directory to prevent filename collisions, appending a counter if needed.

methods.name: _deriveFileName
methods.description: Provides a best-effort method to derive a filename from a PlatformFile.

methods.name: _detectMimeType
methods.description: Attempts to determine the MIME type of the file based on provided metadata and filename extension.

methods.name: deleteStoredFile
methods.description: Deletes a file at a given absolute path if it resides within the application's documents directory; returns true on success or if the file does not exist.

methods.name: isManagedFile
methods.description: Checks if a given absolute path points to a file managed (stored) by the app inside the documents directory.

methods.name: _isSubPath
methods.description: Helper method to verify if a given path is a subpath of the root path, ensuring safety for delete operations.
